4300: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
4307: Sit tall on the floor with your legs crossed or extended.
Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso slowly to one side, keeping your spine long.
Hold for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 8-10 slow rotations each way.
4309: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders, and bring both knees toward your chest.
Place your hands on one shin and extend the other leg out low.
Switch legs smoothly, drawing the other knee in.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your abs tight.
Continue alternating with a steady breath rhythm.
4310: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.
4312: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.
4314: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms or hands on top.
Roll the ball forward as you sink your hips back.
Let your head drop between your arms and lengthen your spine.
Roll the ball back in to come up.
4315: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
4318: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.
4322: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
4326: Lie back on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them bent throughout.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest and repeat.
4327: Lie on your back under the sled and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform until your knees are deeply bent.
Keep your lower back flat on the pad.
Press the platform up without locking your knees.
Lower under control for each rep.
4328: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.
4329: Place a stable chair against a wall and set your hands on the seat edge.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the seat, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
4330: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.
4331: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Extend one leg and lift it a few inches off the floor.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Switch legs halfway through or alternate each rep.
4332: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
4333: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for support.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up and draw a small circle with your knees.
Reverse the circle on the next rep.
Lower your hips slowly each time.
4334: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
4335: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place your other hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, keeping your hips still.
Squeeze the opposite side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.
4336: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
4338: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and a barbell in your hands.
Grip the bar with palms facing up, shoulder-width.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
4339: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.
4340: Lie on a bench with a barbell held wider than shoulder-width above your chest.
Lower the bar behind your head in a smooth arc.
Pull the bar back over your chest.
Maintain a stable core and avoid arching your back.
4341: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other arm.
Avoid swinging; keep alternating for your reps.
4342: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide in an arc with elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your wrists as you lower until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together, twisting them to finish with palms inward.
Control the weight on the way down.
4343: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
4344: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell above your chest, arms straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return to the start.
4345: Lean back on an incline bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar.
Grip the bar close together with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, upper arms still.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
4346: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
4347: Stand facing the machine and set the pad behind your working ankle.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
4348: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Draw your belly button toward your spine.
Hold for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally.
4349: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg, other leg lifted in front.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower as deep as you control.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
4350: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pin your upper arms to the floor beside you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.
4351: Set an incline bench facing away from a low cable and hold the bar overhead.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
4352: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
4353: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the rope above your chest.
Bend your elbows and lower the rope behind your head.
Spread the rope slightly at the end.
4354: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.
4355: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the V bar with elbows at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and slightly forward.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly, elbows still.
4356: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height, hands holding the handle at your chest.
Step away to load the cable and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest, then switch sides.
4357: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends, palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
4358: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
4359: Stand holding a band behind your head, one hand low and one hand high.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Extend your top arm straight overhead.
4360: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep your back close to the bench.
4361: Stand tall with arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
4362: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down into a deep squat.
Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
Drive through your heels to stand.
4363: Stand on one leg and extend the other behind you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Bend your standing knee and lower slowly.
Touch lightly with your back knee if needed.
Drive back up and switch legs.
4364: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
4365: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
4366: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee out to the side.
Crunch your elbow down toward it.
4367: Stand facing a low cable and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the bar with palms up.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
4368: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest.
Spread the rope as you squeeze your back.
4369: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
4370: Sit on a bench under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised block.
Rest the bar across your thighs with a pad.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.
4371: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Set your back firmly against the pad.
Press the handle forward and up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
4372: Lie face down with palms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your body.
Lower into a low plank with elbows tucked in.
Keep your body straight and hold for 20-30 seconds.
4373: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Extend one leg while keeping control of your torso.
4374: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles.
Take a small step forward with a slight lean.
Sweep one arm up and across toward the center of your chest.
4375: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your hips still.
Pass the ball around your head in a smooth circle, keeping it close.
Complete several circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back as the ball passes behind you.
4376: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.
4377: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, then drive them forward and shrug as you pull the dumbbell up.
Drop under it and catch it at your shoulder with a slight knee bend.
Dip a little, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the hang under control.
4378: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab the handles underhand.
Set your shoulders back and down.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Slowly extend your arms without letting your shoulders round forward.
4379: Anchor the band to a sturdy bar or rack and hold it while lying under the anchor point.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
4380: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
4381: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.
4382: Rest the barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.
4383: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball at hip height.
Step your rear foot behind you and load your weight onto it.
Rotate your hips and torso toward the wall.
Throw the ball hard into the wall at chest height.
Catch it, reset, and switch sides after your set.
4384: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Shift your body forward so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Rock back to the start in a slow, smooth motion.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
4385: Start in a forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders stable.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Roll back through the middle to the other side.
Keep the movement controlled and breathe steadily.
4386: Get into a forearm or high plank with a flat back.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one leg straight behind you without rotating your hips.
Repeat on the other leg and alternate.
4387: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.
4388: Kneel on the floor, with your hands behind your head.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Step one foot forward and drive up through it to stand.
Lower back down with control to kneeling.
Alternate the leading leg on each rep.
4389: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs explosively.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you straighten, then lock out your arms.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.
4390: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and keep your torso upright.
4391: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
4392: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
4393: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back a little.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can, and keep your back straight.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.
4394: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back near the wall.
Raise one arm forward and overhead as far as you can without arching.
4395: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
4396: Stand tall, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side without twisting.
Use your obliques to return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.
4397: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Take a split stance with one foot well in front of the other.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
4398: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
4399: Stand with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lift your chest and gently arch backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your legs strong.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.
